clause_text: Licensor hereby grants to Licensee a non-exclusive, revocable, non-sublicensable license to use the Software solely for internal business testing.
Licensor hereby grants to Licensee a non-exclusive, irrevocable, sublicensable license to use the Software in its daily business operations.
Licensor hereby grants to Licensee an exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable, worldwide license to modify, distribute, and exploit the Software.
Subject to the terms and conditions, Provider grants Client a limited, personal, non-exclusive license to access the platform.
Subject to the terms and conditions, Provider grants Client a non-exclusive, worldwide, transferable license to use and run the platform.
Provider hereby grants Customer a sole, exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use, copy, and modify the source code.
Each party's liability under this Agreement shall be limited to direct damages and shall not exceed USD 100,000.
Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid by Client in the preceding 12 months.
Supplier's total aggregate liability under this Agreement for any and all claims shall be strictly capped at USD 1,000.
Except for breach of confidentiality, neither party's liability shall exceed two times the annual subscription fee.
Except for breach of confidentiality and IP indemnity, each party's liability is capped at the total contract value.
Customer's right to recover damages under this Agreement is limited to a maximum refund of the last monthly service fee paid.
Licensee shall have the exclusive right to distribute the Product solely within the state of Oregon.
Licensor agrees not to license the Product to any direct competitor of Licensee listed in Exhibit B during the term.
Supplier shall not sell, license, or distribute the Product to any third party anywhere in the world during the term of this Agreement.
Provider agrees that for a period of six months, it will not offer the custom software to other local retail stores.
Provider covenants that it shall not develop similar software for any of Customer's primary competitors.
Supplier covenants that it will work exclusively with Customer and will not enter into supply agreements with any other buyer.
This Agreement shall become effective on the date on which it has been signed by both parties.
The Effective Date of this Agreement shall be January 1, 2025, regardless of the date of actual signature.
This Agreement shall be retroactively effective from the date three years prior to the date of execution, applying to all past transactions.
The terms of this Agreement shall take effect upon the successful launch of the beta platform.
This Agreement shall be effective as of the date of the first commercial purchase order placed by Customer.
This Agreement shall retroactively take effect from January 1, 2020, and Customer assumes all liabilities from that date forward.
This Agreement shall expire automatically upon the successful completion of the services detailed in Exhibit A.
This Agreement shall expire five (5) years from the Effective Date.
This Agreement shall remain in full force and effect indefinitely until terminated by either party under the conditions of Section 9.
This Agreement shall expire upon the final delivery and acceptance of all milestone deliverables.
This Agreement shall expire exactly three (3) years from the execution date, unless renewed by mutual agreement.
This Agreement shall not expire and shall remain in effect in perpetuity, binding all successors and assigns.
Developer hereby assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in and to the custom deliverables, excluding Developer's pre-existing IP.
Developer hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in and to the custom software deliverables to the Client.
Developer hereby assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in and to all software, tools, and ideas conceived by Developer during the term.
Consultant assigns to Company all intellectual property rights in the written reports created specifically for Company under this project.
Consultant hereby assigns to Company all patents and copyrights developed during the performance of the consulting services.
Consultant assigns to Company all right, title, and interest in all works, designs, patents, and software created by Consultant during the term.
Each party covenants not to sue the other party for any patent infringement claims regarding the specific deliverables provided.
Licensee covenants not to sue Licensor or any of its affiliates or customers for any intellectual property infringement claims whatsoever.
Client covenants not to sue Developer for any bugs, defects, or service interruptions encountered in the software during the warranty term.
Purchaser hereby covenants never to sue Seller or its affiliates for any environmental liabilities associated with the property.
This Agreement may be renewed for successive one-year terms upon the mutual written agreement of both parties at least 30 days prior to expiration.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for additional one-year terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior.
This Agreement shall automatically renew indefinitely for additional five-year terms with a mandatory 15% price increase per renewal.
Client shall have the option to renew this Agreement for one additional term of twelve months by providing written notice.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive terms of two years unless written notice of non-renewal is given 90 days prior.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive five-year terms, with fees adjustment based on the maximum CPI inflation rate.
Tenant shall have a Right of First Offer to purchase the Property if Landlord decides to sell it during the lease term.
Purchaser shall have a perpetual Right of First Refusal to acquire all assets of the Seller before any sale to a third party.
Tenant shall have a Right of First Refusal to lease any adjacent office space, provided Tenant is not in default.
Partner shall have a Right of First Refusal to purchase any shares offered for sale by the other Partner before they are sold to outsiders.
Developer shall deposit the source code of the Software with a recognized escrow agent, to be released to Client only in the event of Developer's bankruptcy.
Developer shall deliver the complete source code and technical documentation of the Software directly to Client's repositories on a weekly basis.
Developer shall deposit the source code of the Software with an escrow agent within 30 days of release, to be updated quarterly.
Developer agrees to store the source code of the Software in an open repository accessible to Client at all times.
Licensee's affiliates shall have the right to use the licensed software, subject to the same terms and conditions as Licensee.
Licensee's affiliates may use the software, provided they sign a joinder agreement agreeing to be bound by this Agreement.
Licensee's affiliates may use the software without limitation, and Licensee shall be jointly and severally liable for all affiliate actions.
Licensor's affiliates may perform obligations under this Agreement on behalf of Licensor.
Licensor's affiliates are authorized to grant licenses under this Agreement, subject to Licensor's written authorization.
Licensor's affiliates may enforce all rights and licenses granted to Licensor under this Agreement directly against Licensee.
Nothing in this Agreement shall prevent either party from purchasing standard commercial software from competing vendors.
The competitive restrictions shall not apply to any affiliate acquired through merger, provided the affiliate is operated independently.
The competitive restrictions shall not apply to any activity conducted by either party that represents less than 5% of its gross revenues.
Each party agrees not to make any disparaging remarks about the other party's products in public marketing materials.
Employee covenants that they will never make any negative, disparaging, or critical statements about the Company or its executives.
The license granted herein is non-transferable, except in connection with a merger or sale of all or substantially all assets.
This license is strictly personal, non-transferable, and may not be transferred, assigned, or sublicensed under any circumstances.
The notice period required to terminate or prevent automatic renewal of this Agreement shall be thirty (30) days.
The notice period required to terminate or prevent automatic renewal of this Agreement shall be one hundred and eighty (180) days.
Licensee may extend the license to its direct subsidiaries with prior written notification to Licensor.
Licensee may extend the license to any affiliate, provided that the total user count across all affiliates does not exceed the limit.
Affiliates of Licensee shall have full, unrestricted access to the licensed platform, and Licensor waives all audit rights over them.
